literal: To those who punish, one day's pleasure; to those who endure, fame until the very end.
translation: For those who retaliate, the pleasure lasts but for a single day; for those who patiently endure, their fame will last until the end of time.
modern: தவறு செய்தவர்களைத் தண்டித்தவருக்கு ஒரு நாள் மட்டுமே இன்பம் கிடைக்கும்; ஆனால் பொறுத்துக் கொண்டவருக்கு உலகம் அழியும் வரை புகழ் நிலைத்து நிற்கும்.
explanation: This couplet contrasts the fleeting satisfaction of taking revenge with the everlasting glory of patience and forgiveness. Those who punish or retaliate against wrongdoers experience a momentary, single day's pleasure of satisfaction. In contrast, those who choose to patiently endure and forgive earn a lasting reputation and fame that endures until the very end of time. The word 'பொன்றும்' refers to perishing or ending, and 'துணையும்' acts as a limit, indicating that their fame will remain as long as the world itself exists.
